title: Graphic primitive afb.gp.v2
description: The AFB graphic-primitive entity (the only one; afb.gp.v1 was removed). Notable points: (1) the instrument is identified by the full composite `instrument_key` (afbws/common.v1.json#/$defs/instrumentKey) instead of the short `ticker`; (2) new kinds `trendline` and `fibonacci` — both two-anchor primitives; their rendering is not specified yet; (3) the primitive's own parameters (`start`, `stop`, `text`) live in the `settings` dictionary, not at the root, so a kind can gain parameters without touching the envelope. ROOT = identity and server-side ownership: `schema`, `id`, `instrument_key`, `kind`, `tradeplan_id` (all other parameters go to `settings`). `settings` is REQUIRED and strictly typed by `kind` (enforced by the `allOf` below, each branch is additionalProperties:false): line/line_enter/line_sl/line_tp → `primitiveSettingsLine` {start}; note → `primitiveSettingsNote` {start, text? (≤160)}; zone/ruler/trendline/fibonacci → `primitiveSettingsTwoPoint` {start, stop}. The former v1 (`afb.gp.v1`, flat start/stop/text) has been removed. Promotes the parked settings.primitives[secid][] draft (draft/primitive.v1.json) into a strict canonical entity. Whether a primitive is REFERENCED BY a tradeplan's condition is still derived fresh from the tradeplans themselves on every read, never persisted here. OWNERSHIP is different and is persisted — see `tradeplan_id`.

settings.description: Primitive parameters, strictly typed by `kind` (see root description). Replaced as a whole on `set`.

tradeplan_id.description: Владеющий торговый план. Проставляется сервером при компиляции плана в сделку (публикация/amend); снимается только при физическом удалении плана. Клиент это поле не задаёт и не меняет — в set-запросе оно игнорируется в пользу хранимого значения. Пустое/отсутствующее — свободный примитив, доступный любому плану. При архивации плана его уровни физически удаляются из этого хранилища, но условия плана НЕ переписываются в числа — план сохраняет исходные ссылки на примитивы; полная копия каждого удалённого уровня (kind/координаты/стиль) переносится в archived_components плана и является источником его исторической отрисовки.

indicatorSettings.description: Display + calculation settings. Required: color/lineWidth/lineStyle. Typed optional keys: seriesType (Line|Histogram|Area|Baseline, absent = Line); period (wma, cot); erPeriod/fastPeriod/slowPeriod (kama); start/maximum/increment (psar). Any other key is allowed (value: number, string or boolean), except `enabled` (per-device view flag, never protocol) — indicators are computed by the frontend, so a new indicator brings its own parameters without a protocol change. Mirrors IndicatorInstance.settings of the frontend chart and `indicators[].settings` of config/_default_.yaml, without the on/off flag.

seriesType.description: Series kind the frontend draws the indicator as; absent = Line.

indicator.title: Chart indicator (user or shared)
indicator.description: `scope: shared` indicators are common to all users and editable only by a manager; `personal` belong to the caller. `settings` carry the parameters. Whether an indicator is shown on the chart is not part of the protocol (per-device view setting kept in the client's localStorage). `type` is an open string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`), not an enum; the server computes only wma/kama/psar (alarm indicator conditions, virtual account), other types are stored and returned as is. Type `cot` is chart-only.

type.description: Indicator type, an open set: indicators are computed by the frontend, so a new indicator needs no protocol change. Known: wma, kama, psar, cot, sma, ema, value_imbalance, volume_imbalance, rel_median, order_flow; `field` is the primary-data pseudo-formula (draws a registry field as is).

inputs.description: Optional input binding `{slot: fieldRef}`. Absent = the formula's default inputs, so existing records keep their meaning. For `type = "field"` the slot `value` is REQUIRED — enforced by the server, not by this schema.

fieldRef.title: Reference to an input series of an indicator.
fieldRef.description: Either a candle column `candles.(open|high|low|close|volume)` or a market.v2 registry field `<source>.<field>` with an optional `@median(N)` suffix (same shape as afbws/market.channel.v2.json#/$defs/fieldRequest; the real bounds of N are enforced by the server).

preset.title: Chart preset (user or shared)
preset.description: A set of indicators with a binding `which indicator is drawn on which pane`. `scope: shared` presets are common to all users and editable only by staff; `personal` belong to the caller. `panes` has three panes: `price` (the candle pane; only indicators whose scale is the price), `upper` and `lower` (the two extra panes). Each pane lists indicator ids (`$defs/indicator.id`); the ORDER is the draw and legend order. An id must not repeat across panes (checked by the server). Referenced indicators must exist and be visible to the author; a shared preset may reference shared indicators only (`validation_error` otherwise); a `field` indicator whose field unit is not `price` on pane `price` is a `validation_error`. Scale compatibility of other indicators on a pane is checked by the frontend.

presetPane.description: Indicator ids on one pane, in draw/legend order.

primitiveKindStyle.title: Display style of one primitive kind.

color.description: hex colour; for `note` the callout line / frame / text colour.

lineStyle.description: lightweight-charts LineStyle: 0 Solid, 1 Dotted, 2 Dashed, 3 LargeDashed, 4 SparseDotted.

primitiveStyles.title: Per-user display styles of primitives by kind (afbws.gp.style.v2).
primitiveStyles.description: Keys are primitive kinds; a kind that is absent has no stored override (the client falls back to its defaults).
